summary: Full backend (pytest, 9/9) and frontend E2E (Playwright, two users) testing of the community habit tracker. Everything in the review request works: sign up and sign in go to /habits, wrong password shows an error, the top nav and sidebar links work, sign out goes to /signin and protected routes redirect there, the share checkbox starts unticked, rows show Shared/Private, users only see their own habits, there are 7 local-date checkboxes including today, Days done and streak are correct (0,1,4 -> 3/2; only 2,3 -> 2/2) and stay correct after reload, non-owners see disabled boxes and get 403 from the API, private habits return 404 to other users and are not listed in Community, Community cards show owner, when text and Days done, and comments show the author's name and the owner can see them.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout (7 wrong attempts all return 401). The playbook suggests one, but the user's spec does not ask for it.

issues: The sidebar is not sticky. On long habit pages, the 'Signed in as' name and the 'My habits' sidebar button scroll out of view.
The top-right 'Habit added' toast briefly covers the top-nav My habits/Community/Sign out buttons. Could move it to bottom-right.

action_items: Optional: move the toaster so it doesn't cover the nav
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and matches the spec. Passwords use bcrypt ($2b$). The cookie is httpOnly, secure, samesite=none. CORS uses explicit origins with credentials. _id is excluded. The streak is counted back from the most recent done day, as the spec says.
get_current_user catches every Exception as 401, which could hide DB errors. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed users (test_*@example.com, ui_a_*/ui_b_*@example.com) along with their habits and comments
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_habit_tracker.py. The alice@example.com/alice123 login works. The UI flow was checked with two newly signed-up users.
